# temps_preview_gateway_settings (Resource)

The gateway container that serves previews of AI sandboxes and branches.

Destroying the resource leaves the settings as they are; it only stops managing them.

Import with `preview_gateway_settings`.

Required API key permissions: `settings:read`, `settings:write`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "temps_preview_gateway_settings" "this" {
  enabled      = true
  auto_upgrade = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_upgrade` (Boolean) Upgrade the gateway with Temps.
- `container_name` (String) Name of the gateway container.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Run the gateway.
- `host_port` (Number) Host port the gateway listens on.
- `image` (String) Gateway image.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Import ID, `preview_gateway_settings`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Singleton: the import ID is the resource type without the prefix.
terraform import temps_preview_gateway_settings.this preview_gateway_settings
```
